families.label: Registro, asset association y servicios de autoría

families.label: Luces y sombras

families.existingTechnique: Delegates sphere/disk/capsule/quad/polygon/simple-point/spot; directional cascaded shadow maps and shadow settings passed to Core.

families.label: Skybox, cielo físico e iluminación de entorno

families.moment: En SkyBox/IBL Core si se demuestra defecto; paper/implementación exactos antes
families.check: Actual: contratos; futuro: radiancia/cielo/IBL/exposición con referencias y A/B

families.label: Reflection probes, SSR y captura cubemap
families.classification: Scene config/capture authoring adapter; reflection rendering in Core
families.existingTechnique: Reflection probe stencil/blend/inner/outer shaders; SSROptions consumed by screen-space trace pass, optional ray-tracing capability branch; cubemap capture.

families.moment: En Reflection/SSR Core ante error medido
families.check: Actual: contratos; futuro: geometría,disoclusiones,reflejos y coste por ruta real

families.label: Planos de oclusión
families.existingTechnique: Registers occlusion-culling plane geometry with its feature processor; not a new Scene culling renderer.

families.moment: Sólo ante problema de visibilidad demostrado
families.check: Actual: identidad; futuro: casos visibles/ocultos y ausencia de falsos descartes

families.label: Capas y pesos espaciales de postFX

families.existingTechnique: PostProcessSettings per entity/view; Scene computes radius falloff max(0,1-distance/radius), shape distance falloff and GradientSampler values. Core blends/sorts per-view settings.
families.decision: Conservar matemáticas propias de influencia y blend per-view Core; sin paper artificial
families.moment: En Scene/Core según dueño de cálculo si hay defecto
families.check: Actual: identidad; futuro: radio/límites/pesos/prioridad y continuidad de mezcla

families.label: Exposición, HDR, color, display mapping y LUT
families.classification: Scene settings adapter plus native editor LUT authoring; GPU color/exposure passes in Core
families.existingTechnique: HDRColorGradingSettings/ExposureControlSettings/LookModificationSettings to Core; HDR grading, ACES/output transforms, LUT generation/blending/apply. EditorScene owns LUT capture/export/publish workflow.
families.decision: Conservar settingsScene, GPU Core y autoría/exportación LUT EditorScene
families.moment: En Core para color; EditorScene para formato/publicación; no adopción ahora
families.check: Actual: factory y GUI general no prueba colorimetría; futuro: LUTroundtrip/exposición/parches/transformexacta A/B

families.label: AO, bloom, DOF, movimiento, distorsión y fog
families.classification: Scene parameter adapters; actual pass/shader implementation in Core
families.existingTechnique: PostProcessFeatureProcessor settings consumed by SSAO/Bloom/DOF/MotionBlur/Panini/FilmGrain/Vignette/Chromatic/DeferredFog passes; authoring component does not implement those GPU algorithms.
families.decision: Conservar passes/shaders existentes; siete anchors no prueban equivalencia a papers
families.moment: En postFX Core por defecto o coste medido; no implementar TAA/GI aquí
families.check: Actual: contratos; futuro: AO/bloom/DOF/movimiento/fog con escena,artefactos y GPU A/B

families.label: Diagnóstico render/ray tracing y grid

families.existingTechnique: Debug settings interfaces; Scene builds grid AuxGeom draw arguments; actual auxiliary geometry and debug feature processors are Core with JE RPI interfaces.
families.moment: Sólo si cambia diagnóstico o geometría
families.check: Actual: identidad; futuro: flags/grid/representación del dato real

families.label: Referencias, superficies y attachments

families.existingTechnique: Entity reference configuration, SurfaceData mesh-ray intersection and attachment entity/bone notifications; not a GPU postprocess.

families.moment: En integración de servicios si hay fallo funcional
families.check: Actual: identidad; futuro: referencias,bone/transform,ray-mesh y lifecycle

Materials authoring/renderer infrastructure belongs to existing JE materials/RI owners; CommonFeaturesAtom is not all of Atom_Feature_Common.
Primary reading scopes attributed to parent; index/abstract reading is not complete paper evaluation.
idTech PDF/EA slides not fully accessible; no full-reading claim.
Current GUI and factory gates do not validate every family visually or prove paper conformance.
Static duplication and code ownership are distinct from algorithm quality/performance.
